title: Form → Sheets / Slack Template
summary: Portfolio demo: contact form POST to mock JSON with optional Google Sheets and Slack hooks — Formspree-alternative style integration template.
problem: Small sites need reliable form submissions routed to spreadsheets or team chat without paying per-seat form SaaS or wiring brittle one-offs.
solution: Self-built portfolio demo (apps/form-to-sheet). Accessible contact form submits to a mock JSON API; the template documents how to plug in Google Sheets append and Slack incoming webhooks. Shows the same integration patterns I use in workflow automation projects — own your endpoint, own your data.
